It says the reverse: the pyrometallurgical and hydrometallurgical processes are the ones that are commercialized, while direct recycling is still at the laboratory stage. The overview puts it this way: recycling processes are commercialized by recovering valuable[1] metals and salts, whereas direct recycling recovers and recondi[2]tions electrode materials for use in new battery production under development at the lab scale[3]. The later section on direct recycling is blunt about its status: The direct recycling process is still at the lab scale[4]. So the document does not support the premise of the question; direct recycling is the least commercially established of the routes, not the most.
